d:
Blindspot addresses the pressing issues in society, particularly the flaws within the Indian education system, that are right in front of us but often go unnoticed or ignored. Naam Sujal takes listeners on a journey, narrating the struggles of his teenage years through the eyes of a forced NEET aspirant. The song is a candid and self-explanatory reflection on the pressures and challenges faced during this phase.
